body: Head 72a6ab10a7 (0 behind main). Gate: check-ci-fast 32/32 OK, test-touched OK (29 passed), check-ci-compile OK. Findings: (1) cache: lane suffix now on shared-key (ci-dev-profile-lib/-cli/-rest), key removed; I'll quote the restore/save keys per lane from this run's logs in the PR body. (2) race: fixed at the race, not by re-sharding. The test must set PROCESS env, because production code reads std::env GIT_CONFIG_COUNT, so a child-only env can't test it. So the test now sets GIT_CONFIG_KEY/VALUE pairs BEFORE the count, and EnvVarsGuard restores LIFO. The process env never holds a count without its pairs, which protects every git-spawning test, not just story_1421. If you'd still rather serialize story_1421 under env_lock, say so. (3) budgets: next push, from 3 post-split PR runs (39383875258 + this run + a rerun) plus 5 post-S6 main runs for the other lanes; lib budget per half. Totals go in the body. (4) union guard refuses repeats too (lib-0/lib-1 count once; their partition is checked at runtime), with LIB_KINDS imported from test-touched.py; tests cover a gap and a repeat. (5) test asserts the check-ci-list Run tests line. Extra for the 9-min target: gates/contracts shell tests reuse the workspace binary (AIDA_CI_PREBUILT_CLI=1) instead of a feature-different cargo build -p aida-cli rebuild, about 2 min in contracts. Items 2-4 (BUG-2179/2184/2174/2189) are still Draft and blocked on your approval.
